source.paraphrase: MessageGate.registerHandler takes handler first, an optional string peer second, and an optional string handlerId third.

invariants.why: The handler is invoked at delivery. A peer in the first slot can be registered as a noncallable handler; the peer and handler IDs occupy separate string slots.
invariants.fixHint: Call kernel.message.registerHandler(handler, peer, handlerId). Omit peer when the intended contract is an anonymous address.

source.paraphrase: MessageGate teardown uses a string peer or the returned subscription ID, never the handler function.

invariants.why: The gate indexes peers and subscription IDs. Passing a handler function can silently leave its registration active.
